_about: FactLot registry coverage by county (5-digit FIPS strings). Generated by scripts/registry/gen_coverage_map.py from the quote-checked coverage rows (docs/registry/coverage.md), the Tier 1 quality audit and the source configs; do not edit by hand. A county not listed is grey: not reviewed, not loaded, gated, sample only, partial, an aggregate with no per-county count, or stale. Counts are commercial parcels (categories B, F1, F2). No natural-person names.

classes.hosted: Registry lookups for this county are served by the hosted API at api.factlot.com on every plan, metered by plan; call registry_coverage to list what is hosted. DC's data is also the downloadable CC BY 4.0 sample database.
classes.audited_load: Whole-county load from a verified source; the quality audit re-read the archived publisher file and found the registry holds exactly its in-scope parcels, with 0 violations. Built, not yet hosted (run it on a self-hosted FactLot).
classes.cited_load: Whole-county load from a verified source with a per-county count and as-of date in the record; not yet covered by the quality audit. Built, not yet hosted (run it on a self-hosted FactLot).
